newsitem.title: CHINA: China Founder subsidiary sales soar.
newsitem.headline: China Founder subsidiary sales soar.

text.p: China's Peking University Founder Electronic Ltd has so far sold more than 280,000 personal computers, accounting for five to six percent of the market for domestically-made computers, a company official said on Friday.
The sales target of the company, a subsidiary of computer software maker and computer distributor Founder (Hong Kong) Ltd, for 1996 was 300,000, she told Reuters by telephone.
"We will open a new production line in late November, then the daily output will be about 1,000," she said.

The company diversified from software into computer hardware production at the end of last year and was competing against China's two major computer producers -- Great Wall and Legend, the official said.
She said the company hoped to take a 10-15 percent market share of domestically-made computers in 1997, but gave no more details.
